# See The Big World

> > Travel guides and cultural exploration across Europe by Ka, a former finance journalist sharing city stories and practical visitor information.

See The Big World (小咖看世界) offers bilingual travel content focused on European destinations including Barcelona, Milan, Paris, Rome, London, and Dublin. The site features detailed attraction guides, transportation tips, and cultural insights with emphasis on UNESCO heritage sites and architectural landmarks by masters like Antoni Gaudí and Domènech i Montaner.

## Key Topics

- Barcelona attractions and Gaudí architecture
- Milan shopping and cultural sites
- Paris museums and landmarks
- Rome historical attractions
- London and Dublin city guides
- UNESCO World Heritage Sites
- European travel transportation
- KLOOK and Get Your Guide bookings
- Ticket information and visitor tips
- Swiss scenic trains
- Netherlands day trips
- Italian luxury shopping
- Spanish modernist architecture
- Museum guides and highlights
